subject: Fraud & Scams
title: The Wells Fargo Fake Accounts
description: One-minute skill: The Wells Fargo Fake Accounts.

hook.text: Wells Fargo employees opened 3.5 million fake accounts — without customers knowing or consenting.

buildup.text: Aggressive sales targets pushed employees to create fake accounts to meet impossible quotas.

discovery.text: Customers were charged fees on accounts they never opened. Some had their credit damaged.

twist.text: The bank fired 5,300 low-level employees but initially protected the executives who set the quotas.

climax.text: Wells Fargo paid $3 billion in fines. Its CEO resigned. The scandal became a symbol of bank culture.

punchline.text: The bank defrauded its own customers — 3.5 million times.

quiz.question: Why did Wells Fargo employees create fake accounts?
options: To meet aggressive sales targets set by management
